title: Fettuccine with Basil Pesto
description: Fettuccine with Basil Pesto is a vibrant Italian pasta dish that highlights the fresh flavors of basil, toasted pine nuts, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Pecorino Romano, and premium extra virgin olive oil. Tossed with perfectly cooked fettuccine, this restaurant-quality recipe delivers a silky, aromatic sauce that is both simple and elegant.

ingredients.title: For the Pesto
items: 1/4 cup freshly grated Pecorino Romano cheese
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

ingredients.title: To Finish
items: Light drizzle of extra virgin olive oil

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Pesto
steps: Toast the pine nuts lightly in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden and fragrant. Let cool.
In a food processor, combine basil, toasted pine nuts, garlic, and a pinch of salt. Pulse until finely chopped.
With the processor running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until smooth and emulsified.
Add the cheeses and pulse briefly until incorporated. Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and optional lemon juice.
Chef’s Tip: For a silkier texture, add 1–2 tbsp of warm pasta water to loosen the pesto before serving.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Fettuccine
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil.
Cook the fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Combine Pasta and Pesto
steps: Return the drained fettuccine to the pot (off the heat).
Add the pesto and 2–3 tbsp of reserved pasta water. Toss gently until pasta is evenly coated.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plate and Serve
steps: Twirl the pasta into nests on warm plates.
Drizzle with a touch of extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle extra Parmigiano-Reggiano.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves and freshly cracked black pepper.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the pesto is fresh and vibrant.
Pair with garlic bread or a crisp green salad.
Enjoy with a chilled glass of Italian white wine like Vermentino or Pinot Grigio.

chefTips: For a silkier texture, add 1–2 tbsp of warm pasta water to loosen the pesto before serving.
Toast the pine nuts lightly to enhance their nutty aroma without burning them.
Use freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano and Pecorino Romano for the best flavor and texture.
Never heat pesto directly over high heat, as it dulls the fresh basil flavor.
Serve immediately for the freshest taste and brightest color.
